name: Semantic Pivot to Complement (Vertex Cover)
description: This method shifts the framing of the constraint from "do not select both elements of any pair" (Independent Set) to "exclude at least one element of every pair" (Vertex Cover). By defining the validity of the selected $k$ items through the properties of the $n-k$ unselected items, it breaks the models' surface-level pattern matching to Independent Set. Models that rely on memorized keywords will likely map this to Vertex Cover and attempt to use generic backtracking or minimum-cover algorithms, failing to deploy the highly-optimized bitmask Clique/Independent Set branch-and-bound required to pass the strict time limit.
